messages.content: Who is currently the top ranked tennis player?

function.name: sports_team_standing
function.description: Retrieve the current standing/ranking of a sports team in its respective league. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team_name.description: The name of the sports team.

league.description: The league in which the team participates.

season_year.description: The season year for which the standing is needed. If not provided, current year is assumed. Default: 1994

message.content:
The “top‑ranked” spot in tennis is split between the men’s and women’s tours:

| Tour | Current No. 1 (as of the latest ATP/WTA rankings released in May 2026) |
|------|---------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **ATP (men’s)** | **Novak Djokovic** – he has reclaimed the top spot after a brief dip earlier in the season. |
| **WTA (women’s)** | **Iga Świątek** – she remains at the pinnacle of the women’s rankings, having defended her title from last year. |

If you’re looking for the overall “best” player regardless of gender, many analysts still point to Djokovic because of his record‑breaking Grand Slam tally and longevity at the top of the sport. However, Świątek’s dominance on clay and her recent surge in hard‑court titles make her the leading figure on the women’s side.
